title: Coffee before the meeting
transcript: Hey, I'm heading down to the cafe. Do you want anything? I'm going to grab a latte before the ten o'clock meeting. Oh, and I heard the meeting got pushed to ten thirty, so we have a bit more time.

questions.question: Where is the speaker going?
questions.explain_zh: 第一句 I'm heading down to the cafe 就說了要去咖啡店。

questions.question: What changed about the meeting?
questions.explain_zh: got pushed to ten thirty，push 在這裡是「延後」。

title: Checking in at the hotel
transcript: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under Chen, checking in for three nights. I requested a room on a high floor if that's still possible. Also, could you tell me what time breakfast is served?

questions.question: How many nights is the guest staying?
questions.explain_zh: 關鍵句是 checking in for three nights，check in for + 天數 就是住幾晚。

questions.question: What did the guest request?
options: A room on a high floor
questions.explain_zh: I requested a room on a high floor，request 比 want 正式，訂房時常用。

questions.question: What else did the guest ask about?
questions.explain_zh: what time breakfast is served，be served 是被動語態，指餐點「被供應」的時間。

title: Running late
transcript: Hi, it's me. I'm running about fifteen minutes late. The train was delayed. Go ahead and order without me, I'll have whatever you're having. Sorry about this.

questions.question: How late will the speaker be?
questions.explain_zh: running about fifteen minutes late。run late 是「進度落後」的固定用法，比 I will be late 自然。

questions.question: Why is the speaker late?
questions.explain_zh: The train was delayed。delay 當被動用，指交通工具誤點。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest?
questions.explain_zh: Go ahead and order without me。go ahead 是「你先做沒關係」的意思。

title: A quick project update
transcript: Quick update on the billing migration. We finished moving the customer records last Friday, which was two days ahead of schedule. The remaining work is mostly testing. I'd say we're about eighty percent done overall. The one risk is that we still haven't heard back from the payments team about the API changes.

questions.question: What is the status of the customer records?
questions.explain_zh: We finished moving the customer records last Friday，而且 two days ahead of schedule 是提前兩天，不是延遲。

questions.question: How far along is the project overall?
questions.explain_zh: about eighty percent done overall。overall 指整體進度，不是單一項目。

questions.question: What is the current risk?
options: No reply from the payments team
questions.explain_zh: we still haven't heard back from the payments team。haven't heard back 是「還沒收到回覆」。

title: Ordering at a restaurant
transcript: I'll start with the soup of the day. For the main course, does the pasta come with any meat? I'm vegetarian. If it does, I'll take the mushroom risotto instead. And just tap water is fine, thanks.

questions.question: What dietary restriction does the customer have?
questions.explain_zh: I'm vegetarian 直接說明是素食者，所以要避開肉類。

questions.question: What will the customer order if the pasta has meat?
questions.explain_zh: If it does, I'll take the mushroom risotto instead。instead 表示替代選擇。

questions.question: What did the customer order to drink?
questions.explain_zh: just tap water is fine，tap water 是免費的自來水。

title: Interview: tell me about yourself
transcript: Thanks for having me. I've been working in software development for about five years, mostly on backend systems. Most recently I led a small team that migrated our entire billing system, which took around eight months. What draws me to this role is the collaborative culture you described earlier.

questions.question: How many years of experience does the speaker have?
questions.explain_zh: I've been working in software development for about five years。現在完成進行式表示持續到現在。

questions.question: What was the speaker's most recent project?
questions.explain_zh: Most recently I led a small team that migrated our entire billing system。most recently 指最近一次。

questions.question: Why is the speaker interested in this role?
questions.explain_zh: What draws me to this role is... draw someone to 是「吸引某人」，後面接的就是原因。

title: Asking for directions
transcript: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the National Museum? Is it within walking distance, or should I take the subway? I've got about an hour before it closes.

questions.question: Where does the speaker want to go?
questions.explain_zh: how to get to the National Museum，get to 是「抵達某地」的常用說法。

questions.question: What is the speaker deciding between?
questions.explain_zh: Is it within walking distance, or should I take the subway，or 連接的就是兩個選項。

title: Declining an invitation politely
transcript: That sounds really fun, and I appreciate you thinking of me. Unfortunately I already have plans that evening. My sister's flying in from overseas and I promised I'd pick her up. Could we do something next weekend instead?

questions.question: Why can't the speaker attend?
questions.explain_zh: My sister's flying in from overseas and I promised I'd pick her up。fly in 指搭機抵達。

questions.question: What alternative does the speaker offer?
questions.explain_zh: Could we do something next weekend instead？用問句提出替代方案，語氣比較軟。

questions.question: How would you describe the speaker's tone?
questions.explain_zh: 先肯定對方、說明原因、再提替代方案，是很標準的禮貌婉拒結構。

title: A delayed flight
transcript: Attention passengers on flight BA two four seven to London. Due to a technical issue, departure has been delayed by approximately two hours. The new estimated departure time is nine forty. Passengers with connecting flights should speak to a member of staff at gate fourteen. We apologize for the inconvenience.

questions.question: How long is the flight delayed?
questions.explain_zh: delayed by approximately two hours，approximately 等於 about，是廣播常用的正式說法。

questions.question: What is the new estimated departure time?
questions.explain_zh: The new estimated departure time is nine forty，也就是九點四十分。estimated 表示只是預估。

questions.question: What should passengers with connecting flights do?
questions.explain_zh: speak to a member of staff at gate fourteen。注意 fourteen（14）和 forty（40）發音容易混淆。

title: Negotiating a deadline
transcript: I want to be upfront with you about the timeline. Delivering everything by the end of the month is technically possible, but I'm not confident we could do it thoroughly. If we can push the deadline back by one week, I'd feel much better about the quality. Alternatively, we could ship the core features on time and follow up with the rest.

questions.question: What does the speaker think about delivering by month end?
options: Technically possible but quality is a concern
questions.explain_zh: technically possible, but I'm not confident we could do it thoroughly。but 之後才是真正的重點。

questions.question: What is the speaker's first proposal?
options: Push the deadline back one week
questions.explain_zh: If we can push the deadline back by one week，push back 是把期限往後推的固定用法。

questions.question: What is the alternative proposal?
options: Ship core features on time and follow up with the rest
questions.explain_zh: Alternatively 之後接的就是第二方案：ship the core features on time and follow up with the rest。

title: A voicemail from the dentist
transcript: Hi, this is Karen calling from Bright Smile Dental. I'm ringing to confirm your appointment on Thursday the fourteenth at three fifteen. If you need to reschedule, please give us a call at least twenty-four hours in advance. Otherwise we'll see you then. Thanks!

questions.question: When is the appointment?
questions.explain_zh: Thursday the fourteenth at three fifteen，注意 fifteen（15）和 fifty（50）發音容易混。

questions.question: How far in advance should you call to reschedule?
questions.explain_zh: at least twenty-four hours in advance，in advance 是「事先」。

title: Ordering coffee to go
transcript: Hi, can I get a large oat milk latte to go? And could you make it extra hot? Oh, and hold the sugar, please. Actually, do you have any of those almond croissants left? I'll take one of those as well.

questions.question: What kind of milk does the customer want?
questions.explain_zh: a large oat milk latte，oat milk 是燕麥奶。

questions.question: What does 'hold the sugar' mean?
questions.explain_zh: hold the + 食材 是「不要加」，點餐常用。

questions.question: What else does the customer order?
questions.explain_zh: I'll take one of those as well，指前面提到的 almond croissants。

title: Gym membership enquiry
transcript: Our standard membership is forty-five a month with no lock-in contract. That gets you access to the gym floor and all group classes. If you want to add personal training, that's an extra thirty per session. We're open five thirty in the morning until eleven at night on weekdays, and eight to eight on weekends.

questions.question: How much is the standard membership?
questions.explain_zh: forty-five a month，a month 等於 per month。

questions.question: What does 'no lock-in contract' mean?
questions.explain_zh: lock-in contract 是有綁約期的合約，no lock-in 表示可隨時取消。

questions.question: When does the gym close on weekends?
questions.explain_zh: eight to eight on weekends，週末是早八到晚八。

title: Weekend plans falling through
transcript: So we were supposed to go hiking on Saturday, but the forecast says heavy rain all weekend. I'd rather not get soaked halfway up a mountain. I was thinking we could push it to next weekend instead, or if you're keen to do something, there's that new exhibition at the museum. Let me know either way.

questions.question: Why is the plan changing?
questions.explain_zh: the forecast says heavy rain all weekend，forecast 是天氣預報。

questions.question: What are the two options offered?
options: A different trail or a movie
questions.explain_zh: push it to next weekend instead, or... that new exhibition，or 連接兩個方案。

questions.question: What does 'push it to next weekend' mean?
questions.explain_zh: push something to + 時間 是「延到某時」。

title: Standup meeting update
transcript: Quick update from me. Yesterday I finished the login refactor and got it merged. Today I'm picking up the password reset flow, which should take most of the day. One blocker: I'm still waiting on design to send over the final mockups for the error states. If those don't land by this afternoon I'll move on to something else.

questions.question: What did the speaker finish yesterday?
questions.explain_zh: I finished the login refactor and got it merged，merge 是把程式碼合併進主分支。

questions.question: What is blocking the speaker?
questions.explain_zh: waiting on design to send over the final mockups，blocker 指擋住進度的事。

questions.question: What will the speaker do if the mockups are late?
questions.explain_zh: I'll move on to something else，move on to 是轉去做別的。

title: Requesting time off
transcript: I wanted to give you plenty of notice. I'm hoping to take the week of the twelfth off. I know that's close to the release, so I've already spoken to Marcus and he's happy to cover the deployment. I'll also make sure all my handover notes are written up before I go.

questions.question: When does the speaker want time off?
questions.explain_zh: the week of the twelfth，the week of + 日期 表示那一週。

questions.question: Who will cover the deployment?
questions.explain_zh: I've already spoken to Marcus and he's happy to cover，cover 是代班。

questions.question: What does the speaker promise to do first?
questions.explain_zh: make sure all my handover notes are written up，handover 是交接。

title: Checking out of a hotel
transcript: Good morning. I'm checking out of room four-oh-nine. Before you run the card, could you just talk me through these two charges? There's one for the minibar, which I don't think I used, and another one labelled service fee. Also, would it be possible to leave my bags here until about four this afternoon?

questions.question: What does the guest question?
questions.explain_zh: talk me through these two charges，talk someone through 是「逐項說明給某人聽」。

questions.question: What does the guest also ask for?
questions.explain_zh: leave my bags here until about four，飯店寄放行李的標準說法。

title: Reporting a lost item
transcript: I think I left my laptop bag on the number forty bus. I got off at the central station stop at around six fifteen this evening. It's a dark grey backpack with a red luggage tag on the handle. There's a laptop inside and, more importantly, my passport. Is there anything you can do?

questions.question: Where was the bag left?
questions.explain_zh: I left my laptop bag on the number forty bus，number forty 是公車路線號碼。

questions.question: How is the bag described?
options: Dark grey with a red tag
questions.explain_zh: a dark grey backpack with a red luggage tag。描述失物要具體，這是實用的句型。

questions.question: What matters most to the speaker?
questions.explain_zh: more importantly, my passport，more importantly 標示出重點。

title: Describing a weakness
transcript: Honestly, I used to take on too much. I'd say yes to everything because I wanted to be helpful, and then I'd be stretched too thin to do any of it properly. What's helped is being more deliberate about it. Now when someone asks, I'll check what's already on my plate before committing.

questions.question: What weakness does the speaker describe?
questions.explain_zh: I used to take on too much，take on 是承接任務。

questions.question: What does 'stretched too thin' mean?
options: Having too much to do well
questions.explain_zh: stretched too thin 是「分身乏術」，事情多到每件都做不好。

questions.question: How has the speaker addressed it?
questions.explain_zh: check what's already on my plate before committing，on my plate 是手上的工作量。

title: A package delivery notice
transcript: We attempted to deliver your parcel today at two forty but nobody was home. We've left it with your neighbour at number twelve. If that's not convenient, you can arrange a redelivery online using the reference number on the card. Please note that we can only hold parcels for seven days.

questions.question: What happened to the parcel?
options: It was left with a neighbour
It was left at the door
questions.explain_zh: left it with your neighbour at number twelve，number twelve 是門牌號碼。

questions.question: How long will they hold parcels?
questions.explain_zh: 關鍵句是 we can only hold parcels for seven days，hold 在這裡是「代為保管」。

title: Feedback in a one-on-one
transcript: Overall I think you've had a strong quarter. The migration project in particular went far more smoothly than I expected. One thing I'd like you to work on is speaking up earlier when something's going off track. You flagged the database issue eventually, but had we known a week earlier we'd have had a lot more options.

questions.question: What does the manager praise?
questions.explain_zh: went far more smoothly than I expected，far more 用來加強比較級，語氣比 much more 更強。

questions.question: What should the employee improve?
questions.explain_zh: speaking up earlier when something's going off track，speak up 是把問題講出來。

questions.question: What does 'going off track' mean?
questions.explain_zh: off track 是偏離軌道，指事情沒照計畫走。

title: Explaining a delay to a client
transcript: I want to be straight with you about where we are. The core functionality is complete and tested. However, the integration with your payment provider has thrown up some issues that were outside what we anticipated. Realistically we're looking at an additional two weeks. I'd rather tell you that now than promise a date we can't hit.

questions.question: What is already complete?
questions.explain_zh: The core functionality is complete and tested，core functionality 指核心功能，是專案溝通的常用詞。

questions.question: How much extra time is needed?
questions.explain_zh: we're looking at an additional two weeks，we're looking at 是「預計會是」。

questions.question: What is the speaker's reasoning for telling the client now?
options: To avoid promising an unrealistic date
questions.explain_zh: rather tell you that now than promise a date we can't hit，hit a date 是趕上期限。

title: Boarding gate change
transcript: This is an announcement for passengers travelling to Singapore on flight SQ two two six. Please note that this flight will now depart from gate thirty-two, not gate twenty-three as previously announced. Boarding will begin in approximately fifteen minutes. Passengers requiring assistance should make themselves known to a member of staff.

questions.question: Which gate should passengers go to?
questions.explain_zh: gate thirty-two, not gate twenty-three。這兩個數字很容易聽混，是廣播聽力的典型考點。

questions.question: When does boarding start?
questions.explain_zh: Boarding will begin in approximately fifteen minutes，in + 時間 表示「再過多久」，不是「在…之內」。

title: Talking about a career change
transcript: I spent six years in finance before moving into data analysis. It wasn't a sudden decision. I'd been doing more and more reporting work, and I found I enjoyed the analytical side far more than the client-facing side. So I took a course in the evenings, built a few projects, and eventually made the switch about eighteen months ago.

questions.question: What was the speaker's previous field?
questions.explain_zh: I spent six years in finance，spend + 時間 + in + 領域 是描述資歷的常見句型。

questions.question: What did the speaker enjoy more?
questions.explain_zh: enjoyed the analytical side far more than the client-facing side，client-facing 指「直接面對客戶」的工作。

questions.question: How did the speaker prepare for the change?
options: Took evening courses and built projects
questions.explain_zh: took a course in the evenings, built a few projects，說明轉職準備的具體行動，面試談轉職時很受用的講法。

title: Pharmacy instructions
transcript: Right, so take one tablet twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening, and always with food. Finish the whole course even if you start feeling better after a few days. If you get any rash or swelling, stop taking them and come straight back to us.

questions.question: How often should the tablets be taken?
questions.explain_zh: one tablet twice a day，twice a day 是一天兩次。

questions.question: What should you do if you feel better early?
questions.explain_zh: Finish the whole course，course 在這裡指整個療程，不是課程。

questions.question: What should you do if a rash appears?
options: Stop and return to the pharmacy
questions.explain_zh: stop taking them and come straight back，straight back 是「立刻回來」。

title: A neighbour asking a favour
transcript: Hey, sorry to bother you. We're away next week and I was wondering if you'd mind feeding the cat. It's just once a day, and the food's all in the cupboard by the door. I'd ask my sister but she's working nights at the moment.

questions.question: What is the favour?
questions.explain_zh: if you'd mind feeding the cat，Would you mind + V-ing 是禮貌的請求句型。

questions.question: How often does it need doing?
questions.explain_zh: It's just once a day，just 用來淡化要求的份量。

questions.question: Why can't the sister help?
questions.explain_zh: she's working nights，work nights 是上夜班。

title: Sprint planning discussion
transcript: Looking at what's left in the backlog, I think we're being a bit optimistic. We've got the search rewrite, the notification bug, and the reporting dashboard, and only two of us for most of next week since Anna's on leave. My suggestion is we drop the dashboard to the following sprint.

questions.question: How many items are in the backlog discussion?
questions.explain_zh: search rewrite、notification bug、reporting dashboard 共三項。

questions.question: Why is capacity limited?
questions.explain_zh: only two of us for most of next week since Anna's on leave，on leave 是請假中。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest?
options: Dropping the dashboard to next sprint
questions.explain_zh: we drop the dashboard to the following sprint，drop something to 是延到下期。

title: Declining a meeting invite
transcript: Thanks for including me, but I'm not sure I'd add much value in this one. It looks like it's mostly about the frontend architecture, which isn't really my area. If there's a specific bit you want my input on, I'm happy to join for that part, or you could just send me the notes afterwards.

questions.question: Why is the speaker declining?
questions.explain_zh: which isn't really my area，area 在這裡指專業領域。

questions.question: What alternative do they offer?
options: Joining for part of it or reading notes
questions.explain_zh: join for that part, or you could just send me the notes afterwards，提供兩個替代方案。

questions.question: What does 'add much value' suggest?
questions.explain_zh: add value 是「帶來實質貢獻」，婉拒時用它顯得是為團隊著想。

title: Interview: why this company
transcript: I've been following what you've built for a couple of years, actually. What stood out to me was the decision to open source the core library last year. That told me something about how the team thinks about the wider community. And from a personal angle, the problems you're solving are ones I've run into myself.

questions.question: How long has the speaker followed the company?
questions.explain_zh: for a couple of years，a couple of 通常指兩個左右。

questions.question: What impressed the speaker most?
questions.explain_zh: What stood out to me was the decision to open source，stand out 是「特別突出」。

questions.question: What is the personal reason given?
questions.explain_zh: the problems you're solving are ones I've run into myself，run into 是遇到。

title: Museum audio guide intro
transcript: Welcome to the National Gallery. This guide will take approximately ninety minutes if you follow the full route. Press the number shown beside each artwork to hear the commentary. Photography without flash is permitted throughout, except in the special exhibition on the lower floor.

questions.question: How long is the full route?
questions.explain_zh: approximately ninety minutes。注意 ninety（90）和 nineteen（19）的發音差異。

questions.question: Where is photography not allowed?
questions.explain_zh: except in the special exhibition on the lower floor，except 標示出例外。

title: Bank fraud alert call
transcript: We're calling about some activity on your account that our system has flagged. There were two attempted transactions this morning, both from an overseas merchant, totalling around four hundred. We've blocked the card as a precaution. I should say that we'll never ask you for your PIN or full password over the phone.

questions.question: How many transactions were flagged?
questions.explain_zh: two attempted transactions this morning。四百是金額不是筆數。

questions.question: What action has the bank taken?
questions.explain_zh: We've blocked the card as a precaution，as a precaution 是「以防萬一」。

questions.question: What does the caller emphasise at the end?
options: They'll never ask for a PIN or password
questions.explain_zh: 這是真銀行的標準做法。反過來說，會問密碼的就是詐騙。

title: Restaurant booking by phone
transcript: Good evening, thanks for calling. Unfortunately we're fully booked at seven, but we do have a table at eight fifteen, or we could squeeze you in at six if that's not too early. How many are in your party?

questions.question: What times are available?
questions.explain_zh: a table at eight fifteen, or we could squeeze you in at six。squeeze someone in 是「勉強擠出位子」。

questions.question: What does 'fully booked' mean?
questions.explain_zh: fully booked 是「訂滿了」，訂位時最常聽到的回應之一。

questions.question: What does the staff member ask at the end?
questions.explain_zh: How many are in your party? party 在餐廳指同行人數。

title: Train ticket machine trouble
transcript: Excuse me, the machine's taken my card payment but it hasn't printed a ticket. I've got the confirmation on my phone here, you can see the amount went through. My train leaves in about twelve minutes so I'm a bit stuck.

questions.question: What is the problem?
options: Payment went through but no ticket
The machine is out of order
The ticket is the wrong type
questions.explain_zh: taken my card payment but it hasn't printed a ticket，注意 but 之後才是問題所在。

questions.question: What proof does the speaker have?
questions.explain_zh: I've got the confirmation on my phone，confirmation 指付款成功的通知，是爭議時最有力的證據。

questions.question: How urgent is it?
options: Train leaves in about twelve minutes
questions.explain_zh: My train leaves in about twelve minutes，說明急迫性有助於得到優先處理。

title: Returning a faulty item
transcript: I bought this kettle about three weeks ago and it's stopped heating up properly. I've got the receipt here. I'd prefer a replacement rather than a refund if you have the same model in stock. If not, then I suppose a refund would have to do.

questions.question: What's wrong with the kettle?
options: It was damaged in the box
questions.explain_zh: it's stopped heating up properly，stop + V-ing 表示某功能停止運作。

questions.question: What does the customer prefer?
questions.explain_zh: prefer A rather than B 是「寧可 A 也不要 B」，退換貨時先講偏好比較有機會如願。

questions.question: What would they accept otherwise?
questions.explain_zh: a refund would have to do，have to do 是「只好將就」。

title: Explaining a process to a new hire
transcript: So whenever you push a change, it goes through automated tests first. If those pass, it gets deployed to staging automatically. Someone from the team then needs to approve it before it reaches production. That approval step is the one people forget, so just give someone a nudge if it's sitting there.

questions.question: What happens first after pushing a change?
questions.explain_zh: it goes through automated tests first，go through 在這裡是「經過某個流程」。

questions.question: What is needed before production?
questions.explain_zh: Someone from the team then needs to approve it，approve 是核准放行。

questions.question: What does 'give someone a nudge' mean?
questions.explain_zh: nudge 是輕推，引申為「提醒一下」，職場很常用。

title: Hotel wake-up call request
transcript: Hi, this is room three-one-seven. Could I book a wake-up call for five thirty tomorrow morning? I've got an early flight. And would it be possible to arrange a taxi for around six fifteen as well?

questions.question: What time is the wake-up call?
questions.explain_zh: a wake-up call for five thirty，wake-up call 是飯店的晨喚服務。

questions.question: What else does the guest request?
questions.explain_zh: arrange a taxi 是請櫃檯代叫車，arrange 比 call 更適合請人代辦。

title: Describing a flatmate situation
transcript: It's mostly fine, honestly. He keeps to himself, pays rent on time, that sort of thing. The only friction is the kitchen. He'll cook something elaborate and then leave everything in the sink for two days. I've mentioned it once but I didn't want to come across as nagging.

questions.question: What is the main issue?
questions.explain_zh: leave everything in the sink for two days，friction 在這裡指摩擦、小衝突。

questions.question: How has the speaker handled it?
questions.explain_zh: I've mentioned it once，用現在完成式表示提過但沒再追究。

questions.question: What does 'come across as nagging' mean?
questions.explain_zh: come across as 是「給人某種印象」，不一定是事實。

title: Asking about a bill
transcript: Sorry, could I just check something on the bill? There's a charge here for eighteen that I don't recognise. We had the two mains, one starter, and two soft drinks. I think the starter might have been counted twice, but I could be wrong.

questions.question: What is the customer questioning?
questions.explain_zh: a charge that I don't recognise，charge 是帳單上的收費項目。

questions.question: What does the customer suspect?
questions.explain_zh: might have been counted twice 是「可能被算了兩次」，用推測語氣避免直接指控。

questions.question: How does the customer phrase the complaint?
options: Tentatively, allowing they might be wrong
questions.explain_zh: but I could be wrong 留了台階，是處理帳單爭議時很有效的說法。

title: Salary expectations
transcript: I'd rather understand the full picture before naming a number, if that's alright. Beyond base salary there's the bonus structure, equity, and how you handle progression. That said, based on what I've seen for similar roles in this market, I'd expect somewhere in the region of eighty to ninety.

questions.question: What does the speaker want first?
questions.explain_zh: understand the full picture before naming a number，full picture 指整體條件。

questions.question: What three things are mentioned besides base salary?
questions.explain_zh: bonus structure（獎金制度）、equity（股權）、progression（升遷），這三項合起來才是完整的待遇。

questions.question: What range does the speaker give?
questions.explain_zh: in the region of eighty to ninety，in the region of 是「大約在…範圍」。

title: Cinema listings
transcript: We've got showings at two forty, five ten, and eight thirty. The eight thirty is nearly sold out, only the front two rows left. Two forty and five ten both have plenty of seats. Tickets are twelve fifty, or nine fifty if you've got a student card.

questions.question: Which showing is nearly sold out?
questions.explain_zh: The eight thirty is nearly sold out，sold out 是售完，nearly 表示快要。

questions.question: How much is a student ticket?
questions.explain_zh: nine fifty if you've got a student card，student card 是學生證，很多場所有優惠。

title: A colleague leaving
transcript: So I wanted you to hear it from me first. I've accepted an offer elsewhere and my last day will be the end of the month. It wasn't an easy decision, this team's been great. I'll make sure everything's documented properly and I'm happy to help with handover after I go if anything comes up.

questions.question: When is the last day?
questions.explain_zh: my last day will be the end of the month，last day 指最後上班日。

questions.question: What does the speaker promise?
questions.explain_zh: make sure everything's documented properly，handover 是交接。

questions.question: Why did the speaker tell this person first?
questions.explain_zh: I wanted you to hear it from me first 是一種禮貌，避免對方從別處聽說。

title: Dealing with a difficult customer
transcript: I completely understand why you're frustrated, and you're right that this shouldn't have happened. What I can do right now is refund the delivery charge and get a replacement sent out on next-day service. What I can't do is guarantee it arrives before the weekend, because that depends on the courier.

questions.question: What does the speaker offer?
options: Refund of delivery plus next-day replacement
questions.explain_zh: 明確講出能做的兩件事：退運費、隔日到貨換貨，比空泛道歉有用得多。

questions.question: What can't they guarantee?
questions.explain_zh: What I can't do is… 明確劃出界線，避免給出做不到的承諾。

questions.question: What technique is the speaker using?
options: Acknowledging then stating what is and isn't possible
questions.explain_zh: 先認同情緒、再明確區分能做與不能做的事，是客服的標準做法。

title: Planning a trip with a friend
transcript: So if we fly out on the Thursday evening, that gives us three full days plus the Monday morning. Flights are about two hundred each at the moment, but they'll go up closer to the date. Accommodation-wise, I found a place near the old town that works out cheaper than the hostel once you split it.

questions.question: How many full days would they have?
questions.explain_zh: three full days plus the Monday morning，full day 是完整的一天，不含頭尾的零碎時間。

questions.question: What is said about flight prices?
options: They'll rise closer to the date
questions.explain_zh: they'll go up closer to the date，closer to the date 是「越接近日期」。

questions.question: Why is the accommodation a good deal?
options: Cheaper than the hostel when split
questions.explain_zh: works out cheaper than the hostel once you split it，work out 是「算起來」。

title: Library opening hours
transcript: The library is open from nine until eight Monday to Friday, and ten until five at weekends. The study rooms need to be booked in advance through the website. Please note that the third floor is closed for refurbishment until the end of March.

questions.question: When does the library close on Saturdays?
questions.explain_zh: 週末是 ten until five，所以五點關門。at weekends 是英式說法，美式說 on weekends。

questions.question: How do you get a study room?
questions.explain_zh: booked in advance through the website，in advance 是事先。

questions.question: What is happening on the third floor?
questions.explain_zh: refurbishment 是整修，動詞是 refurbish，公告常見字。

title: Booking a haircut
transcript: We could fit you in on Wednesday at four, or if you'd rather come at the weekend, Saturday morning has a slot at ten thirty. Do you have a preference for a particular stylist? Rachel's fully booked this week but Tom has good availability.

questions.question: What are the two time options?
questions.explain_zh: fit you in on Wednesday at four 或 Saturday morning… ten thirty。fit someone in 是「安插時間」。

questions.question: Which stylist is available?
questions.explain_zh: Rachel's fully booked… but Tom has good availability。availability 是可預約的空檔。

title: Complaining about a delivery
transcript: The order arrived this morning but two of the items are missing. The invoice lists all five, and I've been charged for all five, but there were only three in the box. I've taken a photo of everything that arrived if that helps.

questions.question: How many items arrived?
questions.explain_zh: there were only three in the box。要注意 two are missing 指的是短少的數量，不是收到的數量。

questions.question: What does the invoice show?
questions.explain_zh: The invoice lists all five。invoice 是發票或請款單。

questions.question: What evidence does the speaker have?
questions.explain_zh: I've taken a photo of everything that arrived。申訴時提供證據能加快處理。

title: Gym class booking
transcript: The six o'clock spin class is full but there's a waiting list, and people do drop out fairly often. Alternatively the seven fifteen yoga still has spaces. Just remember if you book and don't turn up, that counts as a no-show and three of those means a temporary suspension.

questions.question: What is the situation with the spin class?
questions.explain_zh: full but there's a waiting list。waiting list 是候補名單。

questions.question: What happens after three no-shows?
questions.explain_zh: three of those means a temporary suspension。no-show 是訂了卻沒出現。

title: Explaining a technical issue
transcript: So the reason the page is slow isn't the database, which is what we assumed at first. It's actually that we're loading all the images at full resolution even when they're displayed as thumbnails. The fix itself is straightforward, maybe half a day, but we should check whether it affects the mobile app too.

questions.question: What was the original assumption?
questions.explain_zh: isn't the database, which is what we assumed at first。which 引導的子句補充說明前面的整件事。

questions.question: What is the actual cause?
questions.explain_zh: full resolution 是原始解析度，thumbnail 是縮圖 —— 用原圖當縮圖顯示就是這裡效能差的原因。

questions.question: How long is the fix estimated to take?
questions.explain_zh: maybe half a day。straightforward 是「直接了當、不複雜」。

title: Onboarding first week
transcript: For the first week don't worry about being productive. Spend the time reading through the architecture docs, sit in on as many meetings as you can, and pair with someone whenever you get the chance. If you're still finding your feet after two weeks, that's completely normal.

questions.question: What is the advice for week one?
options: Focus on learning rather than output
questions.explain_zh: don't worry about being productive，重點放在熟悉環境而非產出。

questions.question: What does 'sit in on meetings' mean?
questions.explain_zh: sit in on 是旁聽、列席，不主動發言。

questions.question: What does 'finding your feet' mean?
questions.explain_zh: find one's feet 是「站穩腳步、進入狀況」，常用於新環境。

title: Chasing an overdue reply
transcript: I'm just following up on the email I sent last Tuesday about the contract amendments. I appreciate things are busy at your end. If it would be easier to talk it through rather than go back and forth over email, I'm free most of Thursday afternoon.

questions.question: What is the speaker following up on?
questions.explain_zh: the email I sent last Tuesday about the contract amendments。amendment 是修訂條款。

questions.question: What does the speaker offer?
questions.explain_zh: talk it through rather than go back and forth over email。go back and forth 是「來回往返」。

questions.question: How would you describe the tone?
questions.explain_zh: I appreciate things are busy at your end 先體諒對方，是催進度不傷關係的關鍵句。

title: Presenting results to stakeholders
transcript: The headline is that conversion improved by eleven percent. But I want to be careful about the interpretation. We ran this over the holiday period, which historically skews higher anyway. My recommendation is that we run it again in February before we commit to rolling it out everywhere.

questions.question: What was the headline result?
questions.explain_zh: conversion improved by eleven percent。headline 在這裡指「最主要的數字」。

questions.question: What is the concern?
questions.explain_zh: the holiday period, which historically skews higher anyway。skew 是使數據偏斜。

questions.question: What does the speaker recommend?
questions.explain_zh: run it again in February before we commit to rolling it out。commit to 是「正式投入」。

title: Airport security
transcript: Please remove any laptops and tablets from your bag and place them in a separate tray. Liquids must be in containers of one hundred millilitres or less, all inside a single clear plastic bag. Belts and jackets off, but you can keep your shoes on today.

questions.question: What must go in a separate tray?
questions.explain_zh: remove any laptops and tablets… place them in a separate tray。tray 是安檢的置物盤。

questions.question: What is the liquid limit?
questions.explain_zh: containers of one hundred millilitres or less。這是國際通用的隨身液體限制。

questions.question: What can passengers keep on?
questions.explain_zh: you can keep your shoes on today。keep something on 是「保持穿著」。

title: Currency exchange
transcript: Today's rate is one point zero eight, and we charge a flat fee of three fifty rather than a percentage commission. So for two hundred you'd receive around two hundred and thirteen after the fee. Rates do change through the day, so this is only valid right now.

questions.question: How is the fee structured?
options: A flat fee of three fifty
questions.explain_zh: a flat fee of three fifty rather than a percentage commission。flat fee 是固定金額，不隨兌換金額變動。

questions.question: How long is the quoted rate valid?
questions.explain_zh: this is only valid right now。匯率隨時波動，這是換匯常見的提醒。

title: Asking a local for a recommendation
transcript: If you want somewhere touristy, the places along the main square are fine but you'll pay for the location. Honestly, walk about ten minutes north and there's a street with three or four family-run places. The one with the green awning does the best seafood I've had here.

questions.question: What's the issue with the main square restaurants?
options: You pay extra for the location
questions.explain_zh: you'll pay for the location，意思是地點好所以價格比較高。touristy 是「觀光客取向的」。

questions.question: What is recommended instead?
questions.explain_zh: walk about ten minutes north，方向用 north/south 比 left/right 更明確。family-run 是家庭經營的。

questions.question: How is the best place identified?
questions.explain_zh: The one with the green awning。awning 是店門口的遮陽篷。

title: Missed connection
transcript: Because your inbound flight was delayed and both legs were booked on the same ticket, we'll rebook you at no extra cost. The next available service is at six twenty tomorrow morning. We can provide a hotel voucher for tonight, but I'd need you to collect your checked bag first.

questions.question: Why is the rebooking free?
options: Both legs were on the same ticket
It's company policy for all delays
questions.explain_zh: both legs were booked on the same ticket。leg 指行程的一段，同一張票航空公司才有義務負責。

questions.question: When is the next flight?
questions.explain_zh: six twenty tomorrow morning，注意 the next available service 指的是最近一班還有位子的班次。

questions.question: What must the passenger do first?
questions.explain_zh: I'd need you to collect your checked bag first。checked bag 是託運行李。

title: Interview: handling disagreement
transcript: There was a case where I thought we were over-engineering a feature. Rather than pushing back in the meeting, I put together a rough prototype of the simpler version so we had something concrete to compare. In the end we went with a middle ground, which I think was better than either original idea.

questions.question: What was the disagreement about?
questions.explain_zh: I thought we were over-engineering a feature。over-engineer 是「把東西做得比需要的複雜」。

questions.question: How did the speaker handle it?
questions.explain_zh: put together a rough prototype… so we had something concrete to compare。用實物代替爭論。

questions.question: What was the outcome?
questions.explain_zh: we went with a middle ground。middle ground 是折衷方案。

title: Interview: describing your working style
transcript: I work best when I've got a clear goal but some freedom in how I get there. I'm quite structured about planning at the start, then I like to check in regularly rather than disappear for two weeks. And I'd always rather ask a question early than waste a day guessing.

questions.question: What conditions does the speaker prefer?
options: Clear goal with freedom in approach
questions.explain_zh: a clear goal but some freedom in how I get there，這句話同時表達了「要方向」也「要空間」。

questions.question: What is their approach to communication?
questions.explain_zh: check in regularly rather than disappear for two weeks。check in 是簡短回報進度。

questions.question: What do they say about asking questions?
questions.explain_zh: rather ask a question early than waste a day guessing。would rather A than B 是「寧可 A 也不要 B」。

title: Setting up a new phone plan
transcript: The twenty pound plan gives you unlimited calls and texts plus twenty gigabytes of data. If you go over, it's charged at three pounds per gigabyte, or you can set a cap so it just stops instead. There's no contract, so you can leave with thirty days' notice.

questions.question: How much data is included?
questions.explain_zh: twenty gigabytes of data。注意 twenty pound 是價格，twenty gigabytes 是流量。

questions.question: What are the options for going over?
questions.explain_zh: charged at three pounds per gigabyte, or you can set a cap。cap 是上限。

questions.question: How much notice is needed to leave?
questions.explain_zh: you can leave with thirty days' notice。notice 是預告期。

title: A parcel collection point
transcript: Your parcel's at the collection point on Mill Street, open until seven on weekdays. You'll need the barcode from the text message and some form of photo ID. If nobody collects it within ten days it goes back to the sender automatically.

questions.question: What do you need to collect the parcel?
questions.explain_zh: the barcode from the text message and some form of photo ID。some form of 是「某種形式的」。

questions.question: What happens after ten days?
questions.explain_zh: it goes back to the sender automatically。sender 是寄件人。

title: Discussing remote work
transcript: The current arrangement is two days in the office, but which days is up to each team. Ours has settled on Tuesday and Thursday so we overlap for planning. If you need to be fully remote for a period, that's usually fine with a bit of notice, especially outside of release weeks.

questions.question: How many office days are required?
questions.explain_zh: two days in the office。which days is up to each team 表示由團隊自訂哪兩天。

questions.question: Why did the team pick Tuesday and Thursday?
questions.explain_zh: so we overlap for planning。overlap 是時間重疊。

questions.question: When is full remote harder?
questions.explain_zh: especially outside of release weeks 暗示 release week 期間比較不方便。

title: Vet appointment
transcript: She's been off her food for about four days now and she's drinking a lot more than usual. She's normally very active but she's been sleeping most of the day. No vomiting, and as far as I can tell she hasn't eaten anything she shouldn't have.

questions.question: What are the main symptoms?
questions.explain_zh: off her food… drinking a lot more than usual。be off one's food 是「食慾不振」。

questions.question: How long has this been going on?
questions.explain_zh: for about four days now。句尾的 now 強調持續到現在。

questions.question: What does 'as far as I can tell' mean?
options: As far as the speaker knows
questions.explain_zh: as far as I can tell 是「就我所知」，表示不完全確定。

title: A rental viewing
transcript: The flat's available from the first of next month. The rent's twelve hundred including water but not electricity. There's a communal bike store downstairs and one parking permit comes with the property. The current tenants are moving out because they've bought somewhere.

questions.question: What is included in the rent?
questions.explain_zh: including water but not electricity。including 與 excluding 是租屋合約的關鍵字。

questions.question: What comes with the property?
questions.explain_zh: one parking permit comes with the property。permit 是許可證。

questions.question: Why are the current tenants leaving?
questions.explain_zh: they've bought somewhere。somewhere 在這裡指房子，口語省略了 a place。

title: Booking a table for a group
transcript: For parties of eight or more we do ask for a deposit of ten per head, which comes off the final bill. We'd also need to take a pre-order for mains at least forty-eight hours beforehand. Is it a set occasion, or just a general get-together?

questions.question: When is a deposit required?
questions.explain_zh: parties of eight or more。per head 是「每人」，餐廳與活動報價常用。

questions.question: What happens to the deposit?
options: It comes off the final bill
questions.explain_zh: comes off the final bill 是「從最後帳單扣掉」，不是額外收費。

questions.question: How far ahead is the pre-order needed?
questions.explain_zh: at least forty-eight hours beforehand。beforehand 是「事先」。

title: Explaining sick leave policy
transcript: For anything up to three days you can self-certify, so just let your manager know and log it in the system. Beyond that we'd need a doctor's note. Sick days don't come out of your annual leave, and there's no expectation that you make the hours up afterwards.

questions.question: When is a doctor's note needed?
questions.explain_zh: Beyond that we'd need a doctor's note，that 指前面的 three days。self-certify 是自行申報。

questions.question: Do sick days reduce annual leave?
questions.explain_zh: Sick days don't come out of your annual leave。come out of 是「從…扣除」。

questions.question: Must the hours be made up later?
questions.explain_zh: no expectation that you make the hours up。make up hours 是補足工時。

title: Bike repair shop
transcript: The gears just need indexing, that's a quick job. The rear tyre though is pretty worn — I'd replace it rather than patch it. If you're happy for me to do both, it'd be about forty-five all in and ready by tomorrow lunchtime.

questions.question: What is wrong with the gears?
questions.explain_zh: The gears just need indexing。indexing 是調整變速定位，just 表示是小事。

questions.question: What does the mechanic recommend for the tyre?
questions.explain_zh: I'd replace it rather than patch it。patch 是補胎。

questions.question: What does 'all in' mean?
questions.explain_zh: all in 是「全部含在內」的口語說法。

title: Discussing a book
transcript: I nearly gave up about a third of the way in, honestly. The first section is very slow. But it does pick up, and by the end I understood why the beginning had to be like that. I'd say stick with it past the hundred page mark and then decide.

questions.question: What nearly happened?
options: The speaker gave up on the book
The speaker finished in one sitting
questions.explain_zh: I nearly gave up。nearly 表示差一點但沒有真的發生。

questions.question: What does 'it does pick up' mean?
questions.explain_zh: pick up 在這裡是「變得精彩起來」，does 用來加強語氣。

questions.question: What is the advice?
options: Read past page one hundred then decide
questions.explain_zh: stick with it past the hundred page mark。stick with 是「堅持下去」。

title: Booking an interpreter
transcript: For a two-hour meeting we'd normally recommend two interpreters working in shifts, because concentration drops significantly after about thirty minutes. If the budget only allows one, we'd suggest building in a proper break halfway through. What's the subject matter, out of interest?

questions.question: Why are two interpreters recommended?
questions.explain_zh: concentration drops significantly after about thirty minutes。significantly 是「明顯地」。

questions.question: What's the alternative with one interpreter?
questions.explain_zh: building in a proper break halfway through。build in 是「安排進去」。

title: University open day
transcript: Applications close in January but we'd encourage you to submit earlier if you can, partly because it spreads out the workload for you. Entry requirements are on the website, though we do look at the whole application rather than just grades. There's a personal statement and one reference needed.

questions.question: When do applications close?
questions.explain_zh: Applications close in January。close 在這裡是「截止」。

questions.question: What is emphasised about assessment?
questions.explain_zh: we do look at the whole application rather than just grades。do 用來強調。

questions.question: What documents are needed?
options: A personal statement and one reference
questions.explain_zh: a personal statement and one reference。reference 在這裡是推薦信。

title: Car service reminder
transcript: Your vehicle is due for its annual service next month. We've got availability on the fourteenth and the twenty-second. A courtesy car is included at no charge if you need one, but we do need to know in advance as we only have three.

questions.question: What dates are available?
questions.explain_zh: the fourteenth and the twenty-second。注意 fourteenth（14）與 fourth（4）容易聽混。

questions.question: What is said about the courtesy car?
options: Free but must be requested in advance
questions.explain_zh: included at no charge… but we do need to know in advance。courtesy car 是維修期間的代步車。

title: Handling an interruption in a meeting
transcript: Sorry, if I could just finish this point — I think it's relevant to what you're about to say. So the concern is that we're measuring the wrong thing entirely. Right, go ahead, I'm interested in where you were going with that.

questions.question: What does the speaker do?
options: Asks to finish, then hands over
questions.explain_zh: if I could just finish this point 先要求說完，說完後再 go ahead 交還發言權。

questions.question: What is the speaker's concern?
questions.explain_zh: we're measuring the wrong thing entirely。entirely 加強語氣。

questions.question: How does the speaker end?
options: By inviting the other person to continue
questions.explain_zh: I'm interested in where you were going with that，把發言權交回去且表達興趣，不會顯得霸道。

title: Ordering at a bakery
transcript: The sourdough's just out of the oven so it's still warm. We've got two left of the walnut loaf, and the croissants are half price after four if you can come back. Anything to drink with that?

questions.question: What is still warm?
questions.explain_zh: The sourdough's just out of the oven so it's still warm。just out of the oven 是剛出爐。

questions.question: When are croissants half price?
questions.explain_zh: half price after four。half price 是半價。

title: Explaining a bug to support
transcript: It happens every time I try to upload a file over about ten megabytes. Smaller files are fine. The progress bar gets to around eighty percent and then it just resets to zero with no error message. I've tried two different browsers and it's the same in both.

questions.question: When does the problem occur?
questions.explain_zh: every time I try to upload a file over about ten megabytes。every time 表示可穩定重現。

questions.question: What happens at eighty percent?
questions.explain_zh: resets to zero with no error message。no error message 是回報 bug 的重要細節。

questions.question: What has the user already tried?
questions.explain_zh: I've tried two different browsers。先講已排除的可能性能節省來回。

title: Interview: explaining a gap
transcript: There's a nine-month gap on my CV and I'd rather address it directly. I took time out to care for a family member. During that period I did keep my skills current — I completed two certifications and contributed to a couple of open source projects. I've been ready to come back for a while now.

questions.question: How long is the gap?
questions.explain_zh: a nine-month gap on my CV。CV 是履歷，美式常說 resume。

questions.question: What was the reason?
questions.explain_zh: I took time out to care for a family member。take time out 是「暫時離開工作」。

questions.question: What did the speaker do during that time?
questions.explain_zh: keep my skills current 是「保持技能不生疏」，是解釋空窗期最有力的說法。

title: Public transport announcement
transcript: Due to engineering works this weekend there will be no service between Central and Northgate. A replacement bus will operate from outside the station, running every fifteen minutes. Journey times will be extended by approximately twenty-five minutes, so please allow extra time.

questions.question: Why is there no service?
questions.explain_zh: Due to engineering works。engineering works 是軌道維修工程，英國鐵路公告常見。

questions.question: How often does the replacement bus run?
questions.explain_zh: running every fifteen minutes。注意跟後面的 twenty-five minutes 區分，那是延誤時間。

questions.question: How much extra time should passengers allow?
questions.explain_zh: extended by approximately twenty-five minutes。allow extra time 是「多預留時間」。

title: Negotiating a freelance rate
transcript: My standard day rate is five fifty. For a longer engagement like this I'd be willing to come down to five hundred, on the basis that it's booked as a block rather than ad hoc days. What I would ask is that invoices are settled within fourteen days rather than thirty.

questions.question: What is the standard rate?
questions.explain_zh: My standard day rate is five fifty。day rate 是日薪報價。

questions.question: What condition is attached to the lower rate?
questions.explain_zh: on the basis that it's booked as a block rather than ad hoc days。ad hoc 是臨時、不固定的。

questions.question: What does the speaker ask for in return?
questions.explain_zh: invoices are settled within fourteen days rather than thirty。settle an invoice 是付清帳款。

title: Weather warning
transcript: A yellow warning for wind is in place from six this evening until nine tomorrow morning. Gusts of up to seventy miles per hour are expected along the coast. Some disruption to ferry services is likely and there may be delays on exposed sections of road.

questions.question: When does the warning end?
questions.explain_zh: from six this evening until nine tomorrow morning，from…until 界定時間範圍。

questions.question: What is most affected?
questions.explain_zh: Some disruption to ferry services is likely。disruption 是「中斷、擾亂」。

title: Estate agent phone call
transcript: I'm calling about the two-bed on Alder Road. I should be upfront that there's already been an offer, slightly under asking. The vendor hasn't accepted yet, so if you wanted to view it I'd suggest doing that today or tomorrow rather than waiting for the weekend.

questions.question: What is the situation with the property?
options: There's an offer, not yet accepted
questions.explain_zh: there's already been an offer… The vendor hasn't accepted yet。vendor 在房地產指賣方。

questions.question: What does 'under asking' mean?
questions.explain_zh: asking price 是開價，under asking 就是出價低於開價。

questions.question: What is the agent advising?
questions.explain_zh: rather than waiting 表示「而不是等待」，仲介在暗示這間搶手，要盡快看。

title: Course enrolment
transcript: The evening course runs for twelve weeks starting in September, one session a week from seven till nine. There's no formal assessment, but attendance matters — if you miss more than three sessions you won't get the certificate. The fee covers all materials.

questions.question: How long is the course?
questions.explain_zh: runs for twelve weeks。run 在這裡是「持續進行」。

questions.question: What affects getting the certificate?
questions.explain_zh: miss more than three sessions 就拿不到證書，attendance 是出席率。

questions.question: What does the fee include?
questions.explain_zh: The fee covers all materials。cover 在這裡是「涵蓋、包含」。

title: Reporting a workplace issue
transcript: I've thought about whether to raise this and I've decided I should. In the last few team meetings, whenever Sam suggests something it gets picked up, but when Priya says essentially the same thing ten minutes earlier it doesn't. I'm not saying it's deliberate, but I think it's worth someone noticing.

questions.question: What pattern is described?
options: One person's ideas are credited, another's overlooked
questions.explain_zh: 同樣的想法由不同人提出卻有不同待遇，這就是所謂的 credit 分配不均。

questions.question: How does the speaker frame it?
options: As something worth noticing, not necessarily deliberate
questions.explain_zh: I'm not saying it's deliberate 先排除指控意圖，讓對方比較聽得進去。

questions.question: What does 'gets picked up' mean here?
options: Is taken seriously and acted on
questions.explain_zh: pick up an idea 是「接下、採納某個想法」。

title: Insurance claim call
transcript: To process this I'll need the crime reference number from the police report, receipts or proof of purchase for the items, and photos if you have them. Once that's all submitted the assessment usually takes ten working days. I should mention there's an excess of one hundred and fifty on this policy.

questions.question: What three things are needed?
options: Crime reference, proof of purchase, photos
questions.explain_zh: crime reference number 是報案編號，proof of purchase 是購買證明，理賠三要件缺一不可。

questions.question: How long does assessment take?
questions.explain_zh: ten working days，working days 不含週末與假日，跟 calendar days 不同。

questions.question: What is an 'excess'?
questions.explain_zh: excess 是自負額，理賠時要自己先負擔的金額，美式稱 deductible。

title: Discussing childcare arrangements
transcript: The nursery does eight till six, which covers us most days, but the problem is Thursdays when I've got the late meeting. My mum can do the pickup if we ask, though I don't want to make a habit of it. The other option is the after-school club, which runs until seven.

questions.question: What is the problem day?
questions.explain_zh: the problem is Thursdays，說話者先講出唯一有問題的那天。

questions.question: What is the speaker's reservation about their mum helping?
options: Not wanting to rely on it regularly
questions.explain_zh: I don't want to make a habit of it。make a habit of something 是「養成習慣、變成常態」。

questions.question: What is the other option?
questions.explain_zh: after-school club 是校內的課後照顧，runs until seven 指營運到七點。
